# without

<link-summary>Removes every occurrence of the given values from an array.</link-summary>

<web-summary>without() — Removes every occurrence of the given values from an array. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function without<T>(array: T[], ...values: T[]): T[];
```

Values are compared with `SameValueZero`: `without([NaN], NaN)` returns `[]`, which an `indexOf` scan cannot do
because strict equality never matches `NaN`. `-0` and `0` match each other.

The exclusions are collected into a set once, so the cost stays linear in the length of the array instead of the
quadratic scan `filter` plus `includes` would perform. A new array is returned; the input is not modified. Called
with no exclusions, `without` returns a copy.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type  | Description                          |
| :---------- | :---- | :----------------------------------- |
| `array`     | `T[]` | The array to filter. Left untouched. |
| `...values` | `T[]` | The values to exclude.               |

## Returns

`T[]` — a new array without those values, in their original order.

## Throws

| Exception   | Condition                |
| :---------- | :----------------------- |
| `TypeError` | `array` is not an array. |

## Examples

### Excluding values

```javascript
without([1, 2, 3, 2], 2); // => [1, 3] — every occurrence
without([1, 2, 3], 2, 3); // => [1]
without([1, 2], 9); // => [1, 2] — nothing to remove
without([NaN, 1], NaN); // => [1]
```

### Dropping the blanks a column comes with

```typescript
import { without } from "apps-script-utils";

const names = sheet.getRange("A2:A").getValues().flat();

without(names, "", "N/A"); // the real entries, in sheet order
```

### Removing a column from a header row

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="without.ts" include-symbol="visibleHeader"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function visibleHeader(header) {
  return without(header, "internalNote", "_rowHash");
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>
